scientific.integrity: The proof separates source-supplied freeness/Tjurina facts from newly reconstructed local and global equivalence relations. Necessity of the local affine action is obtained from branch 2-jets; sufficiency is an explicit analytic coordinate change. Global scaling is forced by the unique rank-one and rank-two singular members of the pencil.
scientific.limitations: Specific to the Beorchia--Miró-Roig minimal-Tjurina bitangent families with at least three conics; no classification of arbitrary conic pencils or arbitrary nearly free curves is asserted. The originality assessment cannot exclude an unindexed general singularity-theory formulation of the affine local-moduli statement.

title: A one-dimensional local-to-global modulus in minimal-Tjurina bitangent arrangements
